why: The two shapes swap roles. Figure 1: big circle. Figure 2: big circle with a small triangle on top. Figure 3: big triangle with the circle inside. So next: big triangle with a small circle on top, just like figure 2 but with shapes swapped. That is option 3. Option 1 has a square on top, which never appeared.
trick: Look for pairs: figure 4 often does to figure 3 what figure 2 did to figure 1.
